annotations.title: Browse the Atlas Tree or Guided Tour

description: Browse the whole Atlas in the publisher's order: the canonical tree of every published Node, or the guided first learning path, an introduction then steps each naming a Node id with narration. Use to survey what exists or to start learning with no topic in mind. Neither view carries entry text or claims; the tour is null if none is published.

expected_revision.description: Pins this call to the Release (published edition) a prior payload named in 'coherence'; refused as 'revision_changed' if the active Release has changed. Omit for the active Release.

view.description: Choose tree to survey every published Node in canonical order, or tour to follow the publisher's guided first learning path.

name: atlas_navigate

data.description: tree: tree entries (id, title, depth). tour: path (id, title, intro, steps of node id, narration), or null when the Release seals no tour.
